verdict.rationale: Jan is built around fully local inference via llama.cpp, with local model downloads (HuggingFace/GGUF), a local-only OpenAI-compatible API server, and explicit privacy claims of zero data collection and hardware-only execution, corroborated by consistent first-party docs and GitHub README across multiple entries. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the zero-data-collection claim beyond vendor docs.
